column1: # Face glob -> licence files, both relative to svf/ (web/mkindex.py). Hand-written: every face under svf/ must match
# exactly one row and every file named must exist, or mkindex.py exits 2. The first non-OFL/LICENSE file is the face's
# note; the page label comes from its first line. glob<TAB>licence[,licence]; fnmatch, case-sensitive.
# svf/dos: the notes name their faces in their first lines.
